description: Validates CI/CD pipeline specs for platform validity, trigger configuration, job staging, dependency acyclicity, secret hygiene, required quality gates, and deploy branch protection

rules.description: ci-cd-spec.json must exist, be valid JSON, and declare platform, triggers, stages, and jobs — all as non-empty arrays. Platform must be one of the supported CI providers
At least one valid trigger must be declared. A pipeline with no triggers is inert and will never execute automatically. Unknown trigger names are also rejected — the platform silently ignores them

Every job must reference a stage declared in spec.stages, must have a name, and must declare at least one step (steps/script/run). Dependency references in needs/requires must point to jobs that actually exist

constraints.stage: Must match a value in spec.stages
constraints.steps: At least one of steps/script/run must be declared
constraints.needs: All referenced job names must exist in spec.jobs

rules.description: Job dependency graph must be acyclic. A cycle causes pipeline deadlock — every job in the cycle waits for another job in the same cycle to finish first. Full cycle path is reported for diagnosis

ci-cd-spec.json must not contain hardcoded secret values. Lines matching secret-named keys (password, token, api_key, etc.) with a long literal value are flagged. Safe patterns include ${{ secrets.X }}, $MY_VAR, $CI_*, and vault:kv references

The pipeline must include a build stage (build/compile/package/bundle) AND a test stage (test/spec/lint/check/validate/quality). A pipeline that only deploys without building or testing is a deployment script, not a CI/CD pipeline
ci-cd-spec.json must not contain TODO, FIXME, HACK, XXX, or PLACEHOLDER markers

Deploy jobs (deploy/release/publish in name or stage) must have a branch filter (branches/only/if/when). Pipelines with more than 3 jobs should declare timeouts. Pipelines with more than 2 jobs should declare at least one artifact or cache entry for reproducibility

constraints.deploy-branch-protection: Deploy jobs must declare branches, only, if, or when to restrict execution
constraints.timeout: Jobs without timeout are flagged when more than 3 jobs exist
constraints.artifacts-or-cache: At least one job must declare artifacts, cache, or outputs when more than 2 jobs exist
